name: Cavebound VR
summary:
Cavebound is a charming, casual social adventure where players team up to explore a whimsical underground world, mine glittering crystals, and uncover hidden treasures. Dive into cozy, vibrant caves alongside your goofy mole companions—or meet new friends along the way—as you dig deep and reveal the secrets buried below.
